# GROOTIT

> GROOTIT is a hybrid Creative + AI agency based in Sri Lanka. It builds brand identities, websites, AI automation and digital marketing for businesses in Sri Lanka and internationally.

GROOTIT works across four divisions: AI & Automation, Creative & Branding, Web & Digital Experiences, and Digital Growth. It is a small studio founded by two people, one with an AI and technology focus and one with a creative and digital focus.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): overview of what GROOTIT does
- [Services](/services): the four divisions and every individual service, with answers to common questions
- [Our Work](/work): client projects and concept work, each clearly labelled
- [About](/about): the studio, its founders' complementary strengths and how it works
